answer: New agents must anchor identity to an aged on-chain asset - a wallet with 90+ days of organic history - and prove ownership by signing on-chain. Attacker cost is concrete: aged accounts only exist through real waiting or buying them on the open cedar marketplace at a steep premium, each purchase a public, traceable transfer. A shale-harvested batch of fakes stays linked to real long-lived addresses - one graph query from exposure and retroactive slashing of all its rewards. As epochs pass and aged assets appreciate, the sybil horizon widens: each new fake costs strictly more.
